title: Step 1 - Implementing KNN Classification in R: Setup & Data Preparation

cues.en: Instructor: Hello and welcome to this R tutorial.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到 R 教學。

cues.en: Today we're going to implement the K nearest neighbors classifier on R.
cues.zh: 今天在 R 實作 K 最近鄰分類器。

cues.en: So let's start right now.
cues.zh: 現在開始。

cues.en: The first thing we're gonna do is to set the working directory.
cues.zh: 首先設定工作目錄。

cues.en: So right now I'm on my desktop.
cues.zh: 現在在桌面。

cues.en: We're gonna go to machine learning A-Z folder, part three classification, and then Section K Nearest Neighbors.
cues.zh: 進入 Machine Learning A-Z、Part 3 Classification，再到 K-Nearest Neighbors。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: That's the folder we wanna set as working directory.
cues.zh: 這就是要設為工作目錄的資料夾。

cues.en: Make sure that you have the social network ads CSV file.
cues.zh: 確認有 Social_Network_Ads.csv。

cues.en: And if that's the case, you're ready to click on this more button here to set the folder as working directory.
cues.zh: 如果有，點 More，設為工作目錄。

cues.en: Here we go, that's done.
cues.zh: 完成。

cues.en: And now we're gonna use our classification template to be efficient, and generate all the results in a flashlight.
cues.zh: 用分類模板提高效率，迅速產生結果。

cues.en: So I'm gonna select everything from here to the top.
cues.zh: 我選取這裡到最上方的全部內容。

cues.en: There you go.
cues.zh: 完成。

cues.en: Copy, and paste it here.
cues.zh: 複製並貼到這裡。

cues.en: And now we need to change a very few things.
cues.zh: 只需改非常少的地方。

cues.en: First, we need to create the classifier here.
cues.zh: 首先在這裡建立分類器。

cues.en: And we just need to change the titles of our plots in the training set results, and the test set results.
cues.zh: 再改訓練與測試結果圖的標題。

cues.en: Let's do this right now so that we don't forget.
cues.zh: 現在先改，避免忘記。

cues.en: I'm gonna replace classifier by, so it's K-NN.
cues.zh: 將 Classifier 換成 K-NN。

cues.en: So we're just doing this to specify the algorithm that we are plotting.
cues.zh: 只是標明圖中使用的演算法。

cues.en: And here as well, classifier is replaced by K-NN.
cues.zh: 這裡也把 Classifier 換成 K-NN。

cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And now what we all need to do is to create our classifier.
cues.zh: 剩下只需建立分類器。

cues.en: But first, let's select and execute the pre-processing steps.
cues.zh: 不過先選取並執行前處理。

cues.en: So I just need to select everything from here and then press Command or Control + Enter to execute.
cues.zh: 全選，按 Command 或 Control+Enter。

cues.en: (clicks buttons) That's done.
cues.zh: 完成。

cues.en: Alright, so we have our data set.
cues.zh: 已有資料集。

cues.en: We can have a look, that's our data set, our training set and our test set, which are well scaled.
cues.zh: 看一下，資料、訓練集、測試集都已正確縮放。

cues.en: Okay, so as a reminder, the data set contains informations about users in a social network.
cues.zh: 提醒，資料包含社群網路使用者資訊。

cues.en: This social network has a business client, which is a car company that puts ads on this social network.
cues.zh: 社群平台有車商這個企業客戶，在上面刊登廣告。

cues.en: And, this social network gathered not only the informations like the age and the estimated salary of those users, but also took the response to these users to the ad.
cues.zh: 平台不只蒐集年齡、估計薪資，也蒐集廣告回應。

cues.en: That is zero if the user didn't buy the product, the car, and one if the user bought the product.
cues.zh: 沒買車為 0，買了為 1。

cues.en: So, you know, it's a very cool luxury SUV, launched at a ridiculously low price.
cues.zh: 是一輛價格低得驚人的豪華 SUV。

cues.en: So, a lot of people when they saw the ad said "Let's do this, let's get the car.", and we can see there are a lot of buyers.
cues.zh: 很多人看廣告後說「買吧」，所以有很多買家。

cues.en: So yeah, as you can see, it must be a very cool car.
cues.zh: 如你所見，應該是很酷的車。

cues.en: And cheap.
cues.zh: 而且便宜。

cues.en: So, now let's go back to K-NN and create our classifier.
cues.zh: 回到 KNN，建立分類器。

cues.en: So the classifier is a K-NN classifier.
cues.zh: 它是 KNN 分類器。

cues.en: And to create this, we are gonna first import the right library.
cues.zh: 首先匯入正確的套件。

cues.en: We need a library for this, which is by the way called class.
cues.zh: 套件叫 class。

cues.en: So, let's do this.
cues.zh: 現在來做。

cues.en: So if by any chance the class library is not in your packages list, you need to install it using this command install.packages, and in parenthesis and in quotes
cues.zh: 如果套件清單沒有 class，使用 install.packages，括號及引號內

cues.en: the name of the class, which is class but I think you might have it by default.
cues.zh: 填 class；不過我想預設可能已安裝。

cues.en: So, but if that's not the case, please write this command with class inside, then execute and it will install it.
cues.zh: 如果沒有，執行這個命令，就會安裝。

cues.en: But so here we're just gonna write library and in parenthesis class.
cues.zh: 這裡直接寫 library(class)。

cues.en: So that selects automatically the class.
cues.zh: 自動載入 class。

cues.en: You see that right now the class package is not selected.
cues.zh: 現在 class 尚未選取。

cues.en: And once this is executed it will select it automatically.
cues.zh: 執行這行後會自動選取。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And now, now we're gonna do something a little different.
cues.zh: 接下來做法有點不同。

cues.en: Because usually, you know, we create our classifier here and then we create this vector of prediction y_pred using this predict function that we apply on our classifier,
cues.zh: 通常先建立 classifier，再用 predict，將分類器

cues.en: and on new observations in the test set.
cues.zh: 套到測試集新觀測，建立 y_pred。

cues.en: But here it's like we're gonna do this two steps all in once because we are actually going to remove this line and we are actually going to replace this comment
cues.zh: 這裡兩步一次完成，所以移除這行，將註解改為

cues.en: fitting K-NN to the training set and predicting the test set results.
cues.zh: 「將 KNN 擬合到訓練集，並預測測試結果」。

cues.en: Because all in once we're gonna fit K-NN to our training set and predict if the users of our test set buy yes or no, the SUV.
cues.zh: 因為會同時完成訓練與預測測試使用者是否買 SUV。

cues.en: So you're gonna understand why.
cues.zh: 稍後就理解。

cues.en: We're gonna directly create our vector of prediction y_pred here.
cues.zh: 直接建立預測向量 y_pred。

cues.en: And then, you know before we had classifier equals then the SVM or logistic regression.
cues.zh: 先前是 classifier 等於 SVM 或邏輯斯迴歸。

cues.en: Here, it's gonna be directly y_pred equals K-NN.
cues.zh: 現在直接 y_pred 等於 knn。

cues.en: Because actually this K-NN function here will return the predictions of the tested observations.
cues.zh: 因為 knn 函數直接傳回測試觀測的預測。

cues.en: Okay, so now let's have a look at this K-NN function, and you'll get it.
cues.zh: 看看函數，你就明白。

cues.en: So press F1.
cues.zh: 按 F1。

cues.en: Okay, so K nearest neighbor classification.
cues.zh: K 最近鄰分類。

cues.en: Let's first input the arguments.
cues.zh: 先輸入引數。

cues.en: The first argument is train.
cues.zh: 第一個是 train。

cues.en: So you can guess that by train they mean the training set.
cues.zh: 可以猜到，就是訓練集。

cues.en: So here we need to specify what the training set is.
cues.zh: 在這裡指定訓練資料。

cues.en: And actually since we call it training set, it's training_set.
cues.zh: 我們命名為 training_set，所以使用它。

cues.en: So training_set here.
cues.zh: training_set。

cues.en: All right, training_set.
cues.zh: 好，training_set。

cues.en: However, the training set, as you can see contains the independent variables and the dependent variable.
cues.zh: 但訓練集包含自變數與應變數。

cues.en: And we only need to take the independent variables.
cues.zh: 這裡只要自變數。

cues.en: We won't include the dependent variable in the K-NN function here.
cues.zh: 不把應變數放進 knn 的 train 引數。

cues.en: So here we need to take only the first two columns.
cues.zh: 所以只取前兩欄。

cues.en: So we're gonna add a bracket here and then comma, because on the left of this comma is all the lines that I'm taking, all the observations.
cues.zh: 加中括號、逗號；逗號左側是要取的資料列，也就是全部觀測。

cues.en: And at the right of this comma is the columns I wanna include in the training set.
cues.zh: 逗號右側是要納入的欄位。

cues.en: So it's all the columns except for the last one.
cues.zh: 全部欄位，除了最後一欄。

cues.en: So I'm gonna put here minus three, which means that I'm removing the last column of my training set.
cues.zh: 所以填 -3，移除訓練集最後一欄。
